files.why: Add framework-free BillingPeriod entity (id, name, start, end) and a BillingPeriodSummary read model carrying invoice/appointment counts and totals.
Add pure aggregation: filter invoices by a period's date range and sum totals-per-period (Decimal, no float), plus a summarizePeriod projection.
Add billingPeriodDtoSchema (server shape: snake_case, ISO date strings) for period definitions; stays inside data/.
Add toBillingPeriod mapping the period DTO down to the core entity; DTO never leaks upward.
Add fetchBillingPeriods() and a billing-only invoices-in-range fetch feeding the period read model.
Seed period definitions in server shape and add the GET /api/billing-periods MSW handler.
Cross-slice composition point (mirrors useInvoiceList): join a period's invoices with scheduling appointment summaries via @slices/scheduling and compute totals.
Finance-facing list of named periods with per-period totals.
One period drill-down: its appointments, the invoices raised, and totals.
Reusable totals/rows table for periods — a new reason to change, so a new component rather than overloading InvoiceLinesTable.
Add /billing-periods (list) and /billing-periods/:id (detail) route records; app router concatenates them automatically.
Add fetchAppointmentsInRange(start,end) public read model returning AppointmentSummary[] for appointments that happened within a period.
Re-export fetchAppointmentsInRange so billing can consume it through scheduling's public surface (never a deep import).
Expose BillingPeriod/BillingPeriodSummary types (and query if app-level overview needs them); routes already flow via billingRoutes.
Add unit tests for the new pure period-aggregation rules (range filtering + totals).
Add coverage for the toBillingPeriod DTO->core mapper.

uncertain: Where the invoices+appointments join lives: I placed it in a ui/composable to match the canonical useInvoiceList precedent, but the depcruise allow-list would also permit billing/data/queries.ts to import @slices/scheduling. Chose the composable for consistency.

Whether billing/index.ts actually needs new exports — only required if the app ClientOverviewView (or another slice) must render period data; a self-contained billing feature needs no index change beyond the already-exported routes.
Whether a separate BillingPeriodSummaryTable.vue is warranted vs. rendering the table inline in the views; depends on whether list and detail share the same table (rule 6/7).
Keeping period logic in core/rules.ts rather than a new core file — core/ allows multiple files, but I avoided proliferation; a dedicated core/period.ts is defensible if rules grow.
Whether periods are user-managed (needs billing/data/mutations.ts + create/edit UI) or derived from a fixed calendar — I assumed read-only definitions from the server.
questions: Are billing periods created/edited by Finance (CRUD + a create/close endpoint), or are they fixed/derived (e.g. calendar months)? This decides whether we add mutations + editing UI.
'Invoices raised for them' — do we group invoices by issueDate falling in the range, or by the appointmentId of appointments that occurred in the range? The two give different memberships.
'Appointments that happened in it' — only status=completed, or any appointment whose start falls in the range regardless of status (scheduled/cancelled)?
Totals: invoices carry a per-invoice currency — should a period show per-currency totals, or is a single currency guaranteed per period?
Can periods overlap / can one invoice or appointment belong to more than one period, and must ranges be contiguous?
Where should this surface in navigation (own top-level route vs. on the client overview), and is there any Finance-only access/role gating expected?
